subject: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff
messages:
From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecloud.com>; gcp-marketplace@google.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff

Hi Priya / GCP team —

Thanks for the quick intake form submission. Before we lock a go-live window with listings, we want to align on two critical integration points on our side: merchant risk classification (how Acme maps to GCP product SKUs and any merchant-level filters) and procurement/billing mapping for co-sell credits.

Proposed agenda for a 45-minute kickoff:
- Introductions and roles (Redwood / Acme / GCP enablement)
- Merchant risk matrix: required evidence and gating (SOC2, encryption at rest, data residency)
- SKU and billing mapping: how purchases will flow to our billing system + co-sell lead attribution
- Mutual Action Plan: milestones, DocuSign timeline, and who owns which artifact
- Open items / next steps

Can you confirm availability next Tue/Wed (Sept 1–2) and who from Acme procurement should join? I’ve attached a short SKU mapping template and our SOC2 summary for the risk review.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
(Attachment: gcp_listing_sku_mapping.csv, SOC2-type2-2025-summary.pdf)

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecloud.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff

Hi Ava —

Thanks — Tue (Sept 1) 10:00 PT works for us. I’ll have Marcus (procurement lead) and our Security Ops (briefed on SOC2) on the call. A couple of clarifications in advance:

- Merchant risk: we already have SOC2 Type II and a customer-data isolation policy; I’ll bring the evidence but if Redwood needs specific control mappings we can pre-fill that worksheet.
- Billing/sku: Acme wants to confirm whether charges come via GCP marketplace SKUs (Google billing) or routed to Redwood for direct billing with GCP co-sell credits. We need the expected path for invoicing and the co-sell attribution signal (is it a lead-id or invoice mapping?).

I’ve attached Marcus’ contact for procurement intake.

Regards,
Priya
Head of Partnerships, AcmeCloud
priya.singh@acmecloud.com
(Attachment referenced: procurement_contact_v1.vcf)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecloud.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff

Looping in Laura from our billing ops — she’ll need to confirm the exact invoice / SKU flows and whether Redwood will act as reseller (direct billing) or if we will rely on GCP-managed billing. A couple of items for the kickoff deck:

- If GCP invoices end-customer and Redwood receives co-sell credits, we need the credit settlement cadence and a HubSpot lead attribution field to reconcile credits to a deal.
- If Redwood invoices directly (reseller path), we need a reseller agreement snapshot and tax/VAT handling for Acme regions.
- For merchant risk gating, please tell us which controls you want us to map to (e.g., encryption at rest, key management, access reviews) so we can pre-populate the worksheet and speed the review on the call.

Laura — can you pull prior reseller agreement snippets and a one-pager on billing reconciliation?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: GCP Marketplace Enablement <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
To: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecloud.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff

Hi all —

We’ll join the Sept 1 window; confirmed at 10:00 PT. A couple of pre-read items attached that usually unblock listing:
- GCP marketplace technical checklist (we’ll need the SKU manifest and expected pricing tiers)
- Commerce/partner settlement flow doc (explains credit settlement cadence for co-sell)

Note on attribution: GCP recommends adding the following fields to the purchase flow for clean co-sell attribution: gcp_affiliate_id, partner_lead_id, and invoice_reference. If Redwood intends to reconcile credits back to a HubSpot deal, include HubSpot DealID in the invoice metadata — we can confirm which metadata keys survive the purchase path.

See you on the call.

Thanks,
Luis Ortega
GCP Marketplace Enablement
gcp-marketplace@google.com
(Attachments: gcp_technical_checklist.pdf, gcp_commerce_settlement_flow.pdf)

From: ava_chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmecloud.com>, gcp-marketplace@google.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP listing: merchant risk mapping + procurement integration kickoff

Great kickoff this morning — thanks everyone for the time. Notes and immediate action items attached (Mutual Action Plan). Short summary:

- Merchant risk: Acme to provide SOC2 artifact and control mapping by 9/6 (Priya). Redwood will return a gap list and required tech evidence by 9/9.
- Billing path: two options on the table — GCP invoiced (Redwood receives co-sell credits) OR Redwood reseller invoiced. Laura to validate tax/reseller implications and share decision matrix by 9/10.
- Attribution: GCP confirmed fields that survive purchase. Rishi to open a HubSpot custom field (hubspot:HS-239482) and we’ll test metadata flow in the sandbox.
- Next meeting: 9/16 — integration validation with live SKU payload and sandbox purchase test.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_ava-acme.docx, gcp_listing_sku_mapping.csv (filled draft).

A few administrative notes: please use the HubSpot thread HS-239482 for ticketing and include the DocuSign envelope reference when contracts are circulated.

Best,
Ava
Senior Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
(Attachments: mutual_action_plan_ava-acme.docx, gcp_listing_sku_mapping.csv)
